title: Coherent readouts at battle starts and screen handoffs
hypothesis: Reading a battle start as initializing instead of the previous battle's finished state (cook runs sh02 T922, e588 T1500: 'finishing (outcome won)' with the last foe at HP 0; show T744: 'STATE COVERAGE ERROR: harness bug: invalid battle positions'), labelling the game's handoff callbacks as transitions, and reading no save data on a frame that ends mid-callback removes false readouts the model reacts to, so runs reach ROUTE 103 in no more turns than without it.
notes: Uses the finals incumbent, as battle-message-waiting does (the switch is omitted there, so it reads OFF). Activation: the first handoff callback the switch relabels is CB2_NewGame, right after the player name is confirmed (NEW_GAME_CREATED); the stale battle start acts from the second battle. A correctness fix meant ON in both arms of bundle-v-control (onInBoth; the bundle file is edited by the readiness thread), so this standalone entry stays pending.
